summary: Verified full HttpOnly-cookie auth migration on the live app: login sets dos_token HttpOnly+Secure+SameSite=None cookie, reload (with localStorage cleared) restores the session via /auth/me from cookie only, logout clears cookie and redirects to /login, and reload after logout keeps user signed out. All 4 acceptance criteria from the review request passed.

test_evidence.session_restore: After removing localStorage['dos_token'] and reloading, GET /api/auth/me -> 200 (dashboard rendered as Rajesh Sharma / OWNER); confirms cookie is source of truth
test_evidence.logout: POST /api/auth/logout -> 200, dos_token cookie cleared from browser, redirected to /login
test_evidence.post_logout_reload: GET /api/auth/me -> 401 after logout+reload; login screen shown

critical_code_review_comments: Optional hardening: on 401 responses (e.g., cookie expired), interceptor could globally clear the fallback localStorage token and redirect to /login to prevent stale UI state.

AuthContext.persist still stores token in localStorage as a Bearer fallback - by design for backward-compat during migration. Ensure this fallback is eventually removed once all sessions rotate to cookie-only, since keeping a JS-readable copy negates the XSS-hardening benefit of HttpOnly.
refreshTenant() only sets tenant but not user; if the user object can change (role update, workspace switch) consider also refreshing user to avoid drift.
context_for_next_testing_agent: HttpOnly cookie auth migration is verified end-to-end on the frontend. Cookie name is dos_token, set with HttpOnly+Secure+SameSite=None on domain founder-os-58.preview.emergentagent.com. /api/auth/me is called on every mount via AuthContext to hydrate user/tenant from the cookie. Logout button has data-testid='logout-button' in the sidebar (Layout.js). Login inputs use data-testid login-email-input / login-password-input; submit button is button[type='submit']. When testing session persistence in future, explicitly clear localStorage before reload to prove the cookie is doing the work.
rca of the issue: No issue found. Feature works as designed.
